statement.p: Use polynomial fitting to find the formula for the nth term of the sequence (a_n)_{n \ge 1} which starts,
{8, 34, 84, 164, 280}, \ldots Note the first term above is a_1, not a_0.

solution.p: a_n = {n^{3}+6n^{2}+n}\text{.} Here we know that we are looking for a cubic because the third differences are constant. So a_n = an^3 + bn^2 + cn + d\text{.} We can work backwards to find that a_0 = {0}, so we know d= {0}\text{.} Then solve the system,
to find a = {1}, b = {6}, and c = {1}.
